title: About Me
text:
Hello, and welcome to my portfolio.
My name is Sebastian Schwarz, and I am a graduate student pursuing a Master of Science in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University. My academic background combines business, analytics, history, and international studies, providing me with a multidisciplinary perspective on data-driven decision-making and global business challenges.
I previously earned dual bachelor’s degrees in Business Administration (International Business) and History from Chapman University, graduating Cum Laude, along with a minor in German Studies. I also completed a Master of Arts in International Business at Munich Business School in Germany. Through these experiences, I have developed a strong interest in understanding how organizations can leverage data, technology, and strategic planning to solve complex business problems.
Professionally, my experience spans analytics, database management, research, hospitality operations, and international business. At Chapman University’s Center for American War Letters Archives, I worked as a student archivist and database manager, organizing and maintaining large archival datasets. More recently, I have participated in an AI research and database development project at Boston University focused on integrating artificial intelligence tools into investment research workflows and business intelligence systems.
Beyond academics and research, I have spent several years working seasonally in Germany at a family-owned equestrian hotel, where I gained experience in operations management, customer service, marketing support, staffing, and financial administration. I have also organized and guided cultural tours throughout Bavaria, helping international visitors explore the region’s history and traditions.
My interests extend beyond business and analytics. I am passionate about filmmaking and have spent years producing independent films, directing projects, writing scripts, and collaborating with creative teams. I am also an avid student of history, particularly through antique collecting and historical interpretation. These interests allow me to combine analytical thinking with creativity, storytelling, and a deep appreciation for historical context.
Through this portfolio, I showcase academic projects, research initiatives, data analytics work, and professional experiences that reflect my interests in business analytics, artificial intelligence, international business, and strategic decision-making. My goal is to continue developing innovative solutions that connect technology, data, and business strategy while creating meaningful value for organizations and communities.
Thank you for visiting my website, and I invite you to explore my projects and experiences.
